question: Who has been appointed as the new Chairman of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) in December 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santosh Kumar Yadav**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Santosh Kumar Yadav** has been appointed as the new Chairman of the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) in December 2022.
 
• He took over the position from the previous chairman, ensuring the continuity of leadership in NHAI.
 
• The appointment is part of the government's ongoing efforts to enhance the infrastructure and management of national highways in India.
 
• Santosh Kumar Yadav is a senior IAS officer with extensive experience in the infrastructure sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is an autonomous agency of the Government of India, responsible for the management of a network of over 50,000 km of national highways.
 
• Established in 1988, NHAI's primary goal is to develop and maintain the national highways network to international standards.
 
• It operates under the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways and plays a crucial role in the economic development of the country by improving road connectivity.
 
• NHAI has been instrumental in implementing various flagship projects like the Golden Quadrilateral and the North-South and East-West Corridors.
